reviews.title: Do not buy - warps your face and does NOT look like you and customer service doesn’t care
reviews.text: It completely changes the entire shape of my chin, eyebrows…everything…and not in a good way. If it was just a matter of “I don’t like the filters” or “it didn’t look as good as I thought” that would be one thing, but I have gone through ALL of the filters and they do NOT look anything close to me. I contacted customer service to get some help, and they didn’t care at all. There are better apps than this one. Don’t waste your money, and go get one of the better apps. Very frustrating to not even do what it is supposed to, and then to have customer service just blow me off = NO. Definitely wish I could give it 0 stars.

reviews.title: Obvious videos are edited
reviews.text: I’ve been searching for an app that doesn’t make it obvious that you edited the video and this one isn’t it. If you want to use it purely for social media uploads, I’m sure it’s fine, but DO NOT use it if you want to send a video to someone. The file name will say Persona Video in the info. It’s a dead giveaway that you’ve used an app to add filters to your video.
